justifiedNeutralAdditions.justification: A plain two-terminal rectangle labelled Power supply replaces the undecoded perspective shell. The prose establishes generic component identity; side terminal placement is schematic regularization, not a claim to recognize original controls or polarity.
Open circuit and No steady current restate the explicit conditions of both authoritative languages. They are modern English labels, not recovered source words.
Clean dots, exact endpoint alignment, thicker solid strokes and regularized bent lead paths preserve connections and improve readability without inventing supports, hardware, branches or values.

proseComparison.finding: Both languages explicitly join the other ends, close the circuit, and describe opposite currents with repulsion of adjacent parallel current-carrying portions. The connector, opposed arrows and outward displacement relative to dashed positions agree. No direction-only force claim for an arbitrary entire circuit is introduced.

justifiedNeutralAdditions.justification: The labelled generic two-terminal supply abstracts the perspective box without interpreting unknown marks as controls, cells or polarity. Separate return paths and the source component role are preserved.

The continuous outward bows are regularized into diagonal shoulders and exact parallel vertical middle segments. Added intermediate dots are schematic join points, not claimed source hardware. Outward displacement is retained while the parallel relationship is limited to the facing portions named by the prose.
Closed circuit and Opposite currents restate the prose; each added I names a source-visible current arrow, not a force or numerical current. No force arrows or new apparatus are added.
Clean dashed references, enlarged current arrowheads, semantic ink/muted roles and exact connector geometry preserve source trace roles and improve normal-width visibility.

Facing solid middle sections at x210 and x430, y200..440 are parallel and displaced outward from dashed x260/x380 reference traces at y140..500. References remain visibly broken, thinner and muted.
The left triangular head visibly points downward near (210,355); the right triangular head points upward near (430,260). Both are on the solid actual wires and clear of the I labels at x170/x470.
Shoulders and both lower return leads visibly meet their intended dots and supply terminals. No extra cross-wire, hidden break, branch or ambiguous crossing appears.
All five labels fit at normal640/native canvas. The supply text is clear of the box boundary and side terminals; complete margins and all strokes remain inside the canvas.
